item.title: Vehicle Catches Fire on US 67
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — A vehicle fire caused traffic to slow down on US 67.It happened around 1 p.m., near the intersection at Old Ballinger Highway. A Nixle alert was sent out urging travelers to avoid northbound US 67 due to the emergency personnel working the fire. Radio traffic stated that the sedan was fully engulfed. About 10 minutes later, at 1:16 p.m., another Nixle was issued stating that traffic lanes are now open. Learn More Here.

item.title: No. 13 Angelo State Rams to Host UT Dallas This Weekend
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — The No. 13-ranked Angelo State University baseball team will finish a two-week homestand with a four-game series against UT Dallas this weekend.The series begins at 6:30 p.m. Friday, March 13, at Foster Field at 1st Community Credit Union Stadium. Learn More Here.

item.title: Angelo State's Majik Esquivel Earns All-South Central Honors
item.description: SAN ANGELO, TX — Angelo State guard Majik Esquivel has been named second-team All-South Central Region by the Division II Conference Commissioners’ Association, the organization announced Thursday.Esquivel, a sophomore from Lubbock, led the Rambelles in scoring this season with 17.2 points per game, the second-highest average in the Lone Star Conference. Earlier this month, she was named first-team All-LSC. Learn More Here.

item.title: Bronte Names Julian Helms New Head Football Coach
item.description: BRONTE, TX — Bronte ISD announced Julian Helms on Thursday as its new head football coach and athletic director.Helms will arrive from Oglesby, where he was the defensive coordinator for a program that reached the state final in 2023. Learn More Here.

item.title: No. 11 Wall Too Much for TLCA San Angelo
item.description: WALL, TX — The No. 11 Wall Lady Hawks proved to be too much for TLCA San Angelo in Wall on Thursday evening. After moving locations due to the rain earlier this week, the Lady Hawks took advantage of a big 3rd inning to claim a run-rule victory, 14-2.The Lady Eagles took the lead early after two shutout innings from Grace Roeder. In the top of the 3rd inning, Alexa Pena and Roeder crossed home plate to put TLCA San Angelo up 2-0. Learn More Here.
